summary.headline: Century Plyboards Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue hit record INR1,561 crore (+33.5% YoY) and PAT rose 57% to INR83.3 crore, helped by a 7% plywood price hike.
summary.overview: Management reported record quarterly consolidated revenue of INR1,561 crore, up 33.5% YoY, with EBITDA margin excluding forest losses at 13.0% and PAT up 57% YoY to INR83.3 crore. Plywood led, with revenue up 32.4% YoY and EBITDA margin of 16.9%, aided by a ~7% price increase taken in April on chemical input cost pressure. MDF was hit by a planned shutdown for the Andhra Pradesh capacity expansion (700 to 950 CBM/day), causing a sequential revenue decline, though revenue still grew ~29% YoY. Management has stopped giving formal guidance citing volatility, and said capex will be restrained with focus on utilisation and debt reduction.

segments.name: Plywood
segments.commentary: Revenue +32.4% YoY and +8.9% QoQ with 16.9% EBITDA margin after ~7% April price hike. Management attributes growth to price-led dealer stocking plus strong June and July sales.

segments.name: Laminates
segments.commentary: Revenue +14.7% YoY, EBITDA margin 10.2% on mix and utilisation. New home press commissioned, export-grade manufacturing planned from end-July 2026. Volume de-grew QoQ on size adjustment, per analyst question.

segments.name: MDF
segments.commentary: Revenue up ~29% YoY but down sequentially due to Andhra Pradesh expansion shutdown (700 to 950 CBM/day). Management targets 15%+ EBITDA margin without a date.

segments.name: Particle board
segments.commentary: Revenue +155.7% YoY and +29% QoQ on higher utilisation; margins still early-stage. Management expects ~15% margins next year.

segments.name: Logistics (Khidderpore Docks / CFS)
segments.commentary: Operations stabilised and EBITDA-positive; 9,000+ containers handled in July. Management is evaluating a possible strategic partner at valuation accretive to the company.

guidance_outlook: No formal guidance on revenue, volume or margins; management cites volatility from geopolitical developments.
MDF: aim for 15%+ EBITDA margin as soon as possible; growth trajectory to be maintained for FY27.
Particle board: margins to rise quarter-on-quarter with utilisation; ~15% margin targeted next year.
Long-term: ROCE target of 20% for MDF and particle board; long-term debt to be within 1x EBITDA.
Revenue aspiration: INR12,000 crore, implying ~INR4,000 crore incremental revenue; indicative incremental capex ~INR2,500 crore at 1.5-2x asset turnover.
capex_capacity: Hoshiarpur greenfield plywood plant (60,000 CBM per annum) expected to commence in Q3 FY27.
Chennai brownfield plywood capacity: 8,000 CBM/month in Q1, 10,000 in Q2, 12,500 from Q3 FY27.
Andhra Pradesh MDF expanded from 700 to 950 CBM/day during Q1.

Uttar Pradesh plywood plant (~INR200 crore capex) targeted for April 2028 if land is secured by year-end; UP MDF to follow with a lag, timing not finalised. Odisha project still at land-selection stage.

No large capex planned in the near term; third laminate press capex ~INR25 crore; no large MDF or particle board capex planned. Particle board capacity expansion beyond ~240,000 CBM via efficiencies only, not 20%+.
demand_pricing: Industry growing ~5-7%; company estimates its share at 9.5-10% of the industry at end-FY26, targeting 15% in five years (implies 12-15% annual growth).

Price hike: ~7% in plywood (April), ~15% in MDF (part since rolled back as raw material prices moved), ~10% in domestic laminate and slightly lower in exports. Price increases remain above pre-war levels across most segments.
Channel inventory at June-end described as okay; July was a high sales month to date.
Brand spend ~4-4.5% of revenue including schemes. Total Cover assurance programme (10-year, covers furniture-related costs) launched; management states claim ratio of 0.06%.
Management declined to give volume guidance or premium/standard split.

qa_highlights.question: Is plywood growth from industry growth or share gain, and where is market share heading?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says share was 9.5-10% last year and the goal is 15% in five years. Growth was driven by the 7% price hike, dealer stocking and a strong June. Quarterly share is not tracked.

qa_highlights.question: When will balance sheet and gearing improve?
qa_highlights.answer: Debt rose on working capital for ~33% growth in a 60-day debt industry. Cash flows go to debt repayment, with no large capex planned. Target is long-term debt within 1x EBITDA.

qa_highlights.question: Is it possible to give MDF FY27 revenue and margin guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Guidance has been stopped due to volatility. The objective is 15%+ MDF margins and a good growth trajectory.

qa_highlights.question: Will particle board capacity increase by minor capex to ~3 lakh?
qa_highlights.answer: No. The line was pre-designed in two parts. Efficiency gains are possible but a 20%+ increase is unlikely.

qa_highlights.question: Plans for UP and Odisha greenfield projects?
qa_highlights.answer: UP land is not yet secured; target is to acquire by year-end, with the plywood plant by April 2028. Odisha is still in government talks with no land selected. UP MDF timing is not finalised.

qa_highlights.question: Sustainable ROCE for MDF and particle board, given particle board capex and realisation differences?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says the analyst's numbers do not match its capacity basis. The target for both segments is 20% ROCE, which it believes is achievable over time.

qa_highlights.question: Outlook for the logistics business and its structure?
qa_highlights.answer: The business is EBITDA- and cash-flow-positive and not core. A strategic partner may come in at an accretive valuation. Only half of phase 1 of the new port is operating, and CFS is expected to grow double digits.
